description: The public NouGenAI brand surface: green-led, gold-highlighted, shards purple as the named secondary system.
name: nougenai-brand

provenance.note: NouGenAI is green with gold highlights; shards are purple. Keep it restrained — 'don't mardi gras it.' The palette relationships and the restraint rule are locks; this package encodes them, it does not originate them.
provenance.source: Dave brand palette ruling, 2026-11-23 (standing fleet memory)

provenance.note: The glowing green N pin on Nou's chest is the logo, at one-to-one parity; approved and set as the NouGenAI channel profile picture (@NouGenAI-n9w) and verified live. This is why the mark is a pinned asset, never a redraw target.

The N pin asset, pinned byte-for-byte into this package. Dominant face colour measured by sampling the 1600x1600 source: cluster #72fd7c-#75fe7f; the --brand token takes #73fd7c from that measurement.

The first fleet surface styled from the palette locks: NouGenAI green/gold for healthy, red for blocked/stale, purple for relay. Its success was one careful lane working from prose memory; this package exists so the next lane loads spec instead.
provenance.source: Fleet Boards Space (fleet-boards), built and verified 2026-11-25

provenance.note: Build-the-system-once and pin-the-mark modules supply this package's form: a reviewed spec compiled deterministically, with the mark carried as a sha256-pinned asset that check verifies. The course's practices are candidates until Dave rules; the locks above are his, not the course's.
provenance.source: claude-design-reversal.md, Modules 1 and 5 (Google Doc 1SbbZuwbMzUvpjGXHB_Vu0WbfkxpMvV6dIotbk4KfPE4; fleet shard 30224@db4)

provenance.note: INVENTED — Dave's review surface: every specific hex except --brand (measured from the mark): the near-black ground family, the gold #d4af37 and its light-theme derivation #8a6414, the shard purples #a78bfa / #6d28d9, all status triples, the light theme as a whole, the 2/3/4px radii, the rem spacing scale, type sizes, --page-width 80rem, and the system-ui/Consolas font stacks (no brand font has been ruled). Each is a candidate chosen to satisfy the locks and the contrast gates, not a settled value.
